evals.prompt: Create an Agent Skill for {{task/domain}}. It should include a valid SKILL.md and any useful references or scripts.
evals.expected_output: A complete skill directory with valid frontmatter, a concise trigger description, clear workflow instructions, and appropriate optional files.
assertions: The output includes a SKILL.md file
The frontmatter contains a valid name matching the parent directory
The description explains when to use the skill and is under 1024 characters
The body includes a step-by-step workflow
Optional scripts or reference files are only included when they add value

evals.prompt: Revise this existing Agent Skill using the attached feedback and eval failures.
evals.expected_output: A revised skill that addresses the general failure modes, not just narrow examples, and reports validation status.
assertions: The revision keeps the skill scope coherent
The changes generalize from feedback rather than patching only the exact examples
The package validates or clearly reports remaining validation issues
